title: Order auxiliary (bike rack) plates
summary: Learn how to order an auxiliary number plate online if your rear plate is hidden by a mobility device, bike rack, or towed vehicle.
intro:
You must display an auxiliary number plate when your rear plate is hidden by a mobility device or bike rack or by a caravan, trailer or vehicle you are towing.

faqs.q: Who needs an auxiliary number plate?
faqs.a: You must display an auxiliary number plate if your rear plate is hidden by a mobility device, bike rack, or by a caravan, trailer, or vehicle you are towing.

faqs.q: Can I get an auxiliary plate for a trailer or motorbike?
faqs.a: No, auxiliary number plates are not issued to trailers, caravans, motorbikes, or public vehicles.

faqs.q: What happens if I don't display an auxiliary plate?
faqs.a: If you do not display an auxiliary plate clearly and do not use a working rear number plate light, you can be fined.
